briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies AGI race with xAI and DeepSeek

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid escalating compute investments. Global AI funding surges past $11B this quarter as regulatory scrutiny grows.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with multimodal reasoning gains while xAI Grok-3 benchmarks show competitive performance. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta's Llama-4 updates push open-source boundaries.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic AI risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 3nm AI chip production for Google and Microsoft. Amazon announces $4B expansion of AWS AI data centers in Europe.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve coherent long-term planning before 2028?
